name: CTF Services Limited
summary: CTF Services Limited is a conglomerate company with a diversified portfolio of businesses in financial services, toll roads, logistics, construction, and facilities management primarily in Hong Kong and the Chinese Mainland. It offers insurance, investment banking, securities trading, financial planning, and asset management services, including life insurance, medical insurance, critical illness insurance, personal accident insurance, saving insurance plans, annuities, investment-linked assurance schemes, group medical insurance, group life insurance, MPF and general insurance; online securities brokerage, fintech solutions in securities trading, and wealth management; and wealth structuring…
